question.text: A client's Rs. 100 lakh portfolio generated 20% return. Fixed mgmt fee 1.5%, op-expenses 0.5%, performance fee 20% above 10% hurdle (Rs. 1 lakh after fee adjustments), exit load 2%. Net portfolio at year-end (after all fees) is approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per textbook worked example: Gross 120, less op-expenses (0.6), less mgmt fee (1.65), less performance fee (1.55), less exit load (2.32) ≈ Rs. 113.88 lakh. The Trap: Back-of-envelope approximations often overshoot. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 10 textbook worked example. Manager's Pro-Tip: Maintain a fee-waterfall template for client communications — reduces disputes.
